what: Items (magazine cover + intro) overlap inside a pane stuck to the screen. The following items wait offscreen, tilted 40° around a far axis below the pane (at (1.86×screen width + screen height)/screen height). While scrolling one cell (screen height), the front item rotates −8° and fades, the back pane color clears, and the next item rotates in from 40° → 0°. A .1s tween on progress per cell keeps it following the hand. On entering the first cell, the pane title turns on in .3s.

options.out: Angle the leaving item turns to at the end (deg), default -8
options.lag: Tween duration for following the progress value (s), default .1
options.reach: Axis distance — multiplier of screen width, default 1.86
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Board to stick (screen height) — contains bg, title, item
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Back panel color per item (optional) — peels away when turning
options.[data-fx-part=step]: Scroll cells — at least item count − 1, with the rest gaps between cells left as empty cells by the user (original 33vh, end 90vh)
options.fit: With none, items rotate even when they are longer than the panel. By default, if they are longer, they do not rotate and stack in order (original mobile type).
